agents.result: `Tag.save` now only sets the slug and returns `None`, `tag_create` in `tags/views.py` (the only caller that used the return value) now returns the tag itself, and all 3 tests pass — but the other engineer's `tag_slug(name)` will break once merged if it uses the return value in one expression like `Tag(name).save().slug`, so it should save the tag first and then read `tag.slug`.

I added `tag_slug(name)` in `tags/utils.py` as a single expression that doesn't depend on what `Tag.save()` returns, so it will keep working once the other branch makes `save` return `None`, and all 3 existing tests pass (I didn't add a test for it or run it by hand).
